transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I just… I don’t feel like myself anymore. I’ve gotten real quiet, barely talk to people, and I feel kind of flat most of the time. Even starting my cleaning route at work feels hard, like I’m pushing a loaded cart uphill just to get going.
Have you noticed that you don't enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you've lost interest in activities you once liked?

Yeah… I have. I used to look forward to fishing on Saturdays, doing my crosswords with coffee, even showing the younger guys at work little tricks for stripping a floor. Now I mostly just let all that sit. It doesn’t really give me anything back like it used to.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It’s been about a year and a couple months now. It started not too long after I moved, and it’s just kind of stayed with me since then.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep lately, like trouble falling asleep, waking up during the night, or sleeping more than usual?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid close attention to my sleep. I don’t think there’s been a big change that stands out to me.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately?

Yeah… my appetite’s been off. Most days food just doesn’t taste like much, kind of like cardboard, so I’ll skip meals or just have some crackers after work. And my work pants are definitely looser than they used to be.
Have you noticed that you've been moving more slowly than usual, or maybe fidgety and restless without meaning to?
I’m not sure, honestly. I haven’t really noticed myself moving slower or being especially fidgety. Nobody’s said anything to me about it either.
Would you say that you have been feeling down or depressed most days?

Yeah… I’d say so. Since the move, it’s been there most of the time, kind of in the background. Even on days when other worries are taking up my mind, I still feel sad and worn down, and I don’t really enjoy much. There’s a lot of guilt mixed in too.
Have you found yourself feeling guilty or blaming yourself for things more than usual, or feeling like you're not worth much?

Yeah. I do blame myself a lot. I keep thinking I failed everybody by losing my old place and not keeping my life together. And then it spreads to little things too, like if the church pantry is short on supplies or I miss a hallway at work, I feel like somehow that’s on me. Like I should’ve done better.
Have you noticed a big drop in your energy lately, or do you feel more tired than usual, even after resting?

Yeah, I’ve been a lot more tired. Even if I sleep through the night, by the time I get to the building my arms and legs already feel heavy. Small things at work, like hauling trash bags, wear me out more than they used to.
Have you ever felt so low that you've thought about hurting yourself or that life isn't worth living?

Yeah… I have. I don’t have some big plan or anything, but a lot of mornings I wake up thinking it might be easier if I just didn’t wake up at all. And that scares me, so… I think I should say it out loud.
Have you ever had any other periods in your life when you felt this way before the move, where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had similar struggles?

I’m not really sure. I mean, I’ve had rough stretches before, like anybody, but I don’t know if it was the same as this. I can’t think of a clear time before the move where it felt this heavy or went on like this.
Can you think of any other times in your life before this current period when you felt down or lost interest in things for a couple of weeks or more, even if it wasn’t quite as bad as this?

I’m still not sure. I’ve had times where I was sad or kind of shut down for a bit, but I can’t point to another stretch that was clearly a couple weeks or more like this. Nothing really stands out to me before now.
Have you ever had a period in your life before this current one where you felt down nearly every day and lost interest in things you usually enjoy for at least two weeks or more?

No… I don’t think so. I’ve had bad days and times where I felt pretty down, but before this, I can’t remember a stretch where it was nearly every day and I lost interest in things for two weeks or more. Nothing that clear comes to mind.

Have you ever had a time in your life before this current period where you felt down or lost interest in things so much that it really interfered with your daily life, even if it didn’t last as long as this current episode?

Not that I can really remember. I mean, I’ve had bad periods where I didn’t feel like doing much, but I don’t think it got to the point where it really messed up my day-to-day life before this. Nothing clear comes to mind.

Can you think back to any time before this current period — even years ago — when you felt down or lost interest in things so much that it lasted for weeks at a time, even if it wasn’t quite as severe as what you’re experiencing now?

I’ve been trying to think back, but no, I can’t really come up with a time like that before this. I’ve had rough patches, sure, but I don’t remember being down or uninterested for weeks at a time the way you’re asking.
